neutron-superfluidity-identity-1-41229ea.conceptual_definition: In the dense interior of neutron stars, neutrons are expected to form a superfluid. The circulation of the superfluid velocity field \( \mathbf{v} \) around any closed loop is quantized in units of \( \pi \hbar / m_n \) (representing Cooper pairs of neutrons of mass \( 2m_n \)).
neutron-superfluidity-identity-1-41229ea.intuitive_summary: Superfluid rotation in a neutron star's core cannot occur uniformly, but must instead form a lattice of quantized vortices.

higgs-kibble-mechanism-identity-1-246b2a.limits_and_boundary: If the VEV is zero (\( v = 0 \)), symmetry is restored, and the gauge boson is massless.

higgs-kibble-mechanism-identity-1-246b2a.conceptual_definition: In the Abelian Higgs model, this equation calculates the mass \( m_A \) generated for the gauge field \( A_\mu \) as the product of the gauge coupling constant \( g \) and the vacuum expectation value (VEV) \( v \) of the scalar field after spontaneous symmetry breaking.
higgs-kibble-mechanism-identity-1-246b2a.intuitive_summary: Gauge bosons acquire mass by eating Goldstone bosons from the symmetry-breaking Higgs field, with the mass proportional to their coupling strength.
